purpose: Preserve the ingest-side domain invariants of the Portal's single SQLite Operational Store through deep transactional operations: Sender Installation lifecycle records, one-use enrollment codes, capability generations, exact archival of accepted Outbox Messages, Delivery Block and sequence-gap evidence, Sync Checkpoint history, the storage reserve, coherent current-state reads, and each delivery cycle's state derived from archived rows, so callers validate fragment continuity and completions without replaying archived envelopes, and the Source Record index: Source Records identified independently of Sender Installation, append-only projection and retraction evidence indexed from archived items with observing-Sender provenance, and append-only reconciled selections recorded against the evidence they were computed from, and processing: Processing Jobs keyed by Source Record and processor version with expiring fenced leases and bounded retry, immutable Canonical Revisions with an indexed header and an opaque versioned body, Unmodeled, Policy-Pending, and Quarantine outcomes recorded against the reconciled selection they interpret, failed jobs with their attempt history, and quarantine of archived items that cannot be indexed, and policies: append-only Source Selection and Fallback Timezone Policy requests recorded as pending, with explicit supersession and no two live policies applying at once, reads of the requested Fallback Timezone timeline, the applicable Source Selection Policy, and the origins known for each record type, and the reprocessing a Fallback Timezone Policy affects enqueued atomically with it, and summary work: immutable Processor Generation manifests registered and read but not activated, Summary Refresh Jobs keyed by summary identity and an exact generation and policy target, coalesced behind a per-target evidence token with expiring fenced leases and bounded retry, immutable candidate Health Summary revisions stored as opaque canonical bytes with indexed header fields, store-checked Data Watermark positions, and links to their contributing Canonical Revisions, the summary work each pending policy requires, a durable bookmark of evidence changes already turned into refresh requests, and coherent reads of summary evidence and processed delivery positions.

inputs.name: domain_transactions
inputs.description: Caller-supplied lifecycle intents, enrollment-code digests, capability advertisements, accepted-message archival records with exact envelope and receipt bytes, and Delivery Block records, each carrying a timezone-aware Portal time; index entries that pair an archived item's position with its caller-extracted source-system kind, origin, Source Identity, and source modification time; and reconciled selections naming the evidence they select and the evidence head they were computed from; processing intents naming a Source Record, its latest projection selection, a processor version, and a retry bound; lease claims, renewals, completions carrying one interpretation outcome, and transient or deterministic failures, each carrying the caller's lease fence and lease duration; and item quarantines naming an archived item and a health-data-free reason; Fallback Timezone Policy requests naming an IANA timezone, an effective instant or all earlier history, the policies they supersede, the caller's record-type-to-processor-version mapping, and a retry bound; and Source Selection Policy requests naming a derived measure, a record type, the selected origins, an optional inclusive local-date interval, and the policies they supersede; Processor Generation manifests mapping record types to processor versions; summary refresh requests naming summary keys of a derived measure, record type, and local date, a target of one registered generation and a policy horizon, a retry bound, optionally the pending policy whose summary work they are, and optionally the evidence changes they acknowledge; refresh lease claims, renewals, transient or deterministic failures, and completions carrying one candidate Health Summary as opaque header, evidence-manifest, and body bytes with its indexed header fields, Data Watermark positions, and contributing processing outcome identities.

inputs.name: database_file
inputs.description: The one SQLite database file at a deployment-chosen path, with its write-ahead log, either absent or created by this or a later store version, at the schema of the store's known migrations.

inputs.name: free_space
inputs.description: Free bytes on the database file's filesystem compared with the deployment-configured storage reserve at the moment of each write transaction.

inputs.name: sqlite_runtime
inputs.description: The SQLite library version linked into the running Python interpreter.

outputs.name: opened_store
outputs.description: A store handle on a database at exactly the schema of the store's known migrations, with WAL journaling, synchronous FULL, and foreign keys enforced, or a named startup refusal.

outputs.name: archive_result
outputs.description: The Delivery Receipt bytes committed with a newly archived message, or the identical prior receipt for an identical retry with no write.

outputs.name: lifecycle_record
outputs.description: An append-only Sender Installation lifecycle event and the resulting installation state.

outputs.name: coherent_view
outputs.description: Reads served from one SQLite read transaction: installation states and operational facts, accepted envelopes in sequence order, archived items, honored capability generations, sequence gaps, Delivery Blocks, paginated Sync Checkpoint history, storage-reserve status, and one delivery cycle's last archived fragment, chain inputs, counts, and completion; archived items not yet indexed, in archival order; one Source Record's identity, evidence, and selection history; Source Records whose evidence is newer than their latest selection; and health-data-free index counts; Processing Jobs with their attempt history, every processing outcome and Canonical Revision of a Source Record, its latest outcome under one processor version, projection selections awaiting processing under the caller's processor versions, archived items awaiting indexing that are not quarantined, a projection's archived bytes by evidence identity, and health-data-free processing counts at a given time; every recorded policy with its supersession links, the requested Fallback Timezone timeline in effective order, the live Source Selection Policies of one derived measure and record type and the one applicable on a local date, and the origins known for each record type with their Source Record counts; registered Processor Generations, Summary Refresh Jobs with their attempt history, every stored candidate Health Summary of a summary key and the latest one for a target, the live policies that have no summary work yet, evidence changes after the acknowledged bookmark, per-installation processed delivery positions for one record type and processor version, the summary evidence of one measure, record type, local-date range, and target, and health-data-free refresh counts at a given time.

outputs.name: store_refusal
outputs.description: A named refusal that leaves the database exactly as it was before the operation.

outputs.name: index_result
outputs.description: The Source Record and evidence rows an index transaction created, or none for an identical repeat of entries already indexed.

outputs.name: selection_record
outputs.description: An append-only reconciled selection for one Source Record: a current projection, a current retraction, or a Source Conflict over named evidence, recorded with the evidence head it was computed from.

outputs.name: processing_job
outputs.description: A durable Processing Job for one Source Record and processor version, queued, leased, completed, failed, or superseded, with its target selection, attempts, retry bound, and append-only attempt history.

outputs.name: processing_lease
outputs.description: An expiring lease on one Processing Job, identified by a fence that increases with every claim, naming the selection and projection evidence the holder must interpret.

outputs.name: processing_outcome
outputs.description: An immutable outcome recorded atomically with the job's completion: a Canonical Revision, Unmodeled, Policy-Pending, or Quarantine for one selection, processor version, and policy identity; an identical repeat does not append or alter an outcome, and completion still updates its held job and attempt.

outputs.name: item_quarantine
outputs.description: A health-data-free quarantine of one archived projection item whose bytes cannot yield a Source Record key, which removes it from the items awaiting indexing without changing it.

outputs.name: policy_record
outputs.description: An append-only pending Source Selection or Fallback Timezone Policy with its scope, its requested time, the earlier policies it supersedes, and the later policy that supersedes it, if any; an identical repeat returns the existing policy and writes nothing.

outputs.name: policy_reprocessing
outputs.description: Processing Jobs queued, in the same transaction as a Fallback Timezone Policy, for every Source Record of a mapped type whose latest outcome used or needed a fallback policy and that has no open job, and every job leased at that moment marked to be queued again when its held lease completes, with health-data-free counts of both.

outputs.name: processor_generation
outputs.description: An immutable registered Processor Generation: a manifest mapping each record type to one processor version, with its digest and registration time; an identical manifest returns the existing generation and writes nothing. Registration activates nothing.

outputs.name: summary_refresh_request
outputs.description: For each requested summary key and target, an advanced evidence token and either a new queued Summary Refresh Job or the one open job, recorded with any policy link and evidence acknowledgement in the same transaction, with health-data-free counts of jobs enqueued, coalesced, and rearmed.

outputs.name: summary_refresh_job
outputs.description: A durable Summary Refresh Job for one summary key and target, queued, leased, completed, or failed, with its retry bound, attempts, and append-only attempt history including results discarded as stale.

outputs.name: summary_refresh_lease
outputs.description: An expiring lease on one Summary Refresh Job, identified by a fence that increases with every claim, naming the summary key, target, and the evidence token current at the claim.

outputs.name: summary_revision
outputs.description: An immutable candidate Health Summary revision appended atomically with the completion of a lease whose evidence token is still current, holding opaque header, evidence-manifest, and body bytes, their store-computed digests, indexed header fields, Data Watermark positions the store vouches for, and links to contributing Canonical Revisions; a stale completion appends nothing and queues the job again, and a byte-identical result is not appended twice.

observable_effects.name: operational-database-writes
observable_effects.description: Committed SQLite transactions on the Operational Store file and its write-ahead log; a refused or failed operation commits nothing.

owns: the baseline SQLite schema, its later additive migrations in the order recorded, and connection durability settings
transactional invariants for one active or draining Sender Installation, one-use enrollment codes, and append-only lifecycle events
exact envelope and per-item archival, sequence uniqueness and ordering, sequence-gap evidence, and Last Delivery
capability generation monotonicity and the rule that a generation stops being honored only after a later generation's acknowledgement is archived
health-data-free Delivery Block and Sync Checkpoint history records
storage-reserve enforcement at write time and coherent read snapshots
deriving each delivery cycle's last archived fragment, its chain inputs, its fragment and record counts, and its completion from archived rows, without a schema change
Source Record identity by source-system kind, origin, record type, and Source Identity, never by Sender Installation, with every observing installation kept as provenance
indexing each archived ingest item exactly once as append-only projection or retraction evidence, idempotently for identical repeats
append-only reconciled selections that refuse to record against evidence newer than the selection was computed from
Processing Jobs keyed by Source Record and processor version, at most one open at a time, that interpret the record's latest projection selection when claimed
expiring leases fenced by a per-claim identity, recovery of expired leases, and the caller's retry bound enforced atomically, including when an expired lease is reclaimed
recording exactly one immutable outcome per selection, processor version, and policy identity atomically with the job's completion, and refusing a different outcome for the same key
append-only Canonical Revisions with indexed header columns and opaque header and body bytes, and append-only health-data-free attempt history
quarantine of archived items whose projection bytes cannot be indexed, without changing the items or the index
append-only Source Selection and Fallback Timezone Policy requests recorded as pending in one arrival order shared by both kinds, with append-only supersession links that the caller names
the invariants that no two live Fallback Timezone Policies start at the same instant and no two live Source Selection Policies for one derived measure and record type apply to the same local date
queueing the reprocessing a Fallback Timezone Policy affects in the same transaction as the policy, and queueing again each job whose lease was held when the policy was recorded
reads of policy history, the requested Fallback Timezone timeline, the applicable Source Selection Policy, and the origins known for each record type
immutable Processor Generation manifests, each mapping record types to processor versions, identified in registration order and by content digest, registered and read without activation
Summary Refresh Jobs keyed by summary key and target, at most one open at a time, coalesced behind a per-key-and-target evidence token that every request advances
expiring fenced refresh leases, recovery of expired leases, and the caller's retry bound enforced atomically, with newer evidence always given another run instead of a stale result or failure

appending an immutable candidate Health Summary revision only for a lease whose evidence token is still current, with opaque header, evidence-manifest, and body bytes, store-computed digests, and indexed header fields

Data Watermark positions on stored summaries that match the store's own archived and processed records, and contributor links only to Canonical Revisions of the summary's record type, processor version, and local date
linking each pending policy to the summary work requested for it, with a target that includes it, and reading the live policies that have none
a durable bookmark of processing outcomes, selections, and failed Processing Jobs already acknowledged by a refresh request, advanced only in the same transaction as that request

reads of Processor Generations, refresh jobs, stored summaries, processed delivery positions, and the summary evidence of a measure, record type, local-date range, and target from one read transaction
does_not_own: wire decoding, delivery evaluation, chain calculation, receipts, or compatibility decisions
Operator intent, enrollment-offer issuance, or when lifecycle transitions happen
Polling Freshness classification or clock-skew conditions
extracting origin, Source Identity, or modification time from projection bytes, or deciding which evidence is current
interpreting projections, choosing an outcome or quarantine reason, choosing which processor version each record type maps to, retry policy, or backoff timing
upgrading an existing database to a later schema
HTTP ingress, Authorized Ingress, or the deployment's reserve value
proposing, confirming, or validating a timezone against the pinned tzdata, choosing origins, choosing what a policy supersedes, or the meaning of a derived measure
choosing which Fallback Timezone timeline or Processor Generation a processor uses

parsing or validating summary header, evidence-manifest, or body bytes, deriving a summary, attributing evidence to a local date, choosing the keys or target an evidence change or policy affects, or choosing when to request a refresh

Cutover Targets, Candidate Builds, current selectors, Cutover Records, Processor Generation and policy activation, ordinary or cutover publication, publication conditions, and per-cycle terminal-outcome counts, which operational-store@7 adds

activation-review tokens, rejection facts, Compound Cutover, Reconciliation Failure history, Reconciliation Absence, Abandoned Attempt Evidence, and Start Fresh Reconciliation, which operational-store@8 adds
Amendments and presentation reads, including per-record-type counts of evidence no daily summary places, which operational-store@9 adds
the Deletion Ledger, privacy erasure of summaries, contributions, and attempt history, Export Jobs, and backup capture metadata, which operational-store@10 adds
